title: Apply owner-approved --radius token (C-03 gate)

npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --target es2020 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler tailwind.config.ts (scoped; repo-wide tsc resource-constrained)

npx vitest run __tests__/design-system (2 files / 5 tests) + theme/style-adjacent (__tests__/dashboard/dashboard-themes.test.ts, __tests__/post-styles/post-style-boundary.test.ts, __tests__/post-styles/premiere-styles-v3.test.ts) (22 tests)

evidence: SCOPED BUILD PROOF (tailwindcss v3.4.17 CLI, tailwind.config.ts, probe content 'rounded-lg rounded-md rounded-sm', exit 0): output.css emits exactly `.rounded-lg { border-radius: var(--radius) }`, `.rounded-md { border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px) }`, `.rounded-sm { border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 4px) }` (plus tailwindcss-animate enter/exit keyframes). RUNTIME RESOLUTION with the applied `--radius: 0.5rem` at :root (node proof): lg = 0.5rem (8px), md = 0.375rem (6px), sm = 0.25rem (4px) — the owner-accepted values. Before DESIGN-033 these computed to 0 (border-radius initial: var(--radius) undefined at :root -> invalid at computed-value time).

TAILWIND FORMULA VERIFICATION (tailwind.config.ts extend.borderRadius, lines 80-84, UNCHANGED): lg = 'var(--radius)', md = 'calc(var(--radius) - 2px)', sm = 'calc(var(--radius) - 4px)' -> with --radius: 0.5rem exactly 0.5/0.375/0.25rem. No correction needed.

Git diff vs HEAD also shows pre-existing other-lane dirt in the same file (epk-font-* utilities, DESIGN-032 sidebar/chart block, DESIGN-030 Phase 5 neon composite removals) — preserved unmodified. Point-in-time var sweep vs HEAD: 13 DESIGN-032 sidebar/chart declarations + 1 DESIGN-033 --radius = 14 new -- declarations total, all registered; no unregistered token introduced.
